backendQuotaError: Model quota exceeded (quota window exhausted): the server keeps retrying but will never succeed — stop this turn and switch model/plan, or wait for the quota to reset
sessionInactiveHint: Session slots are full (server limit 16; opened sessions never auto-release): restart the IDE to free the slots, then resend your message or reopen the session from the history list
modelSwitchInactiveHint: Model switch failed (session not yet active): reopen the session from the history list or send a message, then switch again
modelSwitchDeferred: Model switch will take effect after the current turn: {{model}}
modelCaptchaGated: Trial-plan models require CAPTCHA (slider) human verification, which the plugin cannot complete. Pick a personal-plan or API-key model instead.
modelSwitchStallHint: The first turn after a model switch has produced no output for over a minute and may be stuck server-side (usually a transient model-server outage): stop and resend, or switch back to the previous model.
protocolDead: The ZCode background process crashed and was restarted automatically. This turn was terminated — if unfinished, please resend your message
streamLost: No stream events for over a minute and no server-side progress; this turn was closed as interrupted. If the task is unfinished, send again (sessions resumed after a CLI upgrade/restart may not emit events)
promptRunningHint: The previous turn is still running and auto-stop failed. Try again later, or click Stop to end the current generation before sending
resumeBusyHint: The session may still be resuming (the server needs ~1-2 minutes to digest a recovered interrupted turn); the plugin retries subscribing and settings automatically — do not restart the IDE. Thought-level and other settings return once recovered
dialogElapsedTitle: Ask-question auto-continue is off: the request waits indefinitely for your answer
dialogCountdownTitle: If unanswered until timeout, the request is auto-declined and the dialog closes
